newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia economy to strengthen - Costello.
newsitem.headline: Australia economy to strengthen - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday recent good economic data, combined with the latest cut in official interest rates, set the scene for solid economic growth in 1997/98 and lasting jobs growth.

"Economic growth will strengthen as the year progresses and the benefits of this latest easing in rates, combined with previous interest rate reductions, flows through to borrowers," Costello said in a statement.

"In the last week, announcements on inflation, wages, the 1996/97 budget outcome, international trade in goods and services and monetary policy show the settings are in place for solid economic growth in 1997/98 and such growth to be sustained, generating lasting employment.
"This will only be achieved if inflation continues to remain low and this in turn will require continued moderation in wage outcomes," he said.
The Reserve Bank of Australia earlier on Wednesday cut official cash rates 0.5 percentage points to 5.0 percent, the fifth such cut in a year.
Recent official data has shown low inflation, low wages growth, a record trade surplus in June and a better-than-expected budget deficit for the fiscal year to June 30.
